sample.question:
The jewel board should be invariant under every 90-degree clockwise rotation about its center. Coordinates are zero-based (row,column) from the top-left. A ? is a missing tile and must be restored.
What is the minimum number of tile replacements, counting the missing tile, needed to make the whole board rotationally symmetric?
A. 0
B. 2
C. 3
D. 4
E. 5
F. 1
sample.analysis: For each rotational orbit, keep its most frequent visible color and replace every other or missing member. Summing len(orbit)-max_frequency over all orbits gives 1. The answer is F.
